<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="10%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Item&nbsp;8.01.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Other Events </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On April&nbsp;21, 2010, the
Company announced that it had a fire and explosion onboard its semisubmersible drilling rig Deepwater Horizon. The incident occurred April&nbsp;20, 2010 at approximately 10:00 p.m. central time in the United States Gulf of Mexico. The rig was
located approximately 41 miles offshore Louisiana on Mississippi Canyon block 252. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The rig was staffed with a 126 member crew, 11 remain
missing and 115 have been safely evacuated. The rig sank late in the morning, April&nbsp;22, 2010. The combined response team was not able to stem the flow of hydrocarbons prior to the rig sinking, and we are working closely with BP
Exploration&nbsp;&amp; Production, Inc. and the U.S. Coast Guard to determine the impact from the sinking of the rig and the plans going forward. The U.S. Coast Guard has plans in place to mitigate any environmental impact from this situation.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The cause of the fire and explosion is unknown at this time. An investigation into the cause of the incident and assessment of the damage
will be ongoing in the days or weeks to come. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Statements regarding&nbsp;any future aspect of the incident on the Deepwater Horizon,
the&nbsp;effects, results, investigation, damage assessment relating thereto, mitigation of environmental impact, as well as any other statements that are not historical facts, are forward-looking statements that involve certain risks, uncertainties
and assumptions. These include but are not limited to results of searches, investigations and assessments, actions by the Coast Guard and other governmental agencies, actions by customers and other third parties and other factors detailed in
Transocean&#146;s most recent Form 10-K and other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), which are available free of charge on the SEC&#146;s website at <I>www.sec.gov</I>. Should one or more of these risks or uncertainties
materialize, or should underlying assumptions prove incorrect, actual results may vary materially from those indicated. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The press release
dated April&nbsp;22, 2010 included as Exhibit 99.1 to this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated herein by reference. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<HTML><HEAD>
<TITLE>Press Release</TITLE>
</HEAD>
 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="right"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px">

<IMG SRC="g59185g42b53.jpg" ALT="LOGO"> </P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>TRANSOCEAN LTD. PROVIDES UPDATE ON </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SEMISUBMERSIBLE DRILLING RIG DEEPWATER HORIZON </B></FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">ZUG, SWITZERLAND&#151;Transocean Ltd. (NYSE: RIG) (SIX: RIGN) provided an update today regarding a fire and explosion onboard its
semisubmersible drilling rig <I>Deepwater Horizon</I> and reports that the rig sank late in the morning, today. The combined response team was not able to stem the flow of hydrocarbons prior to the rig sinking, and we are working closely with BP
Exploration&nbsp;&amp; Production, Inc. and the U.S. Coast Guard to determine the impact from the sinking of the rig and the plans going forward. The U.S. Coast Guard has plans in place to mitigate any environmental impact from this situation.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The incident occurred April&nbsp;20, 2010 at approximately 10:00 p.m. Central Time in the United States Gulf of Mexico. The
rig was located approximately 41 miles offshore Louisiana on Mississippi Canyon block 252. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The cause of the fire and
explosion is unknown at this time. An investigation into the cause of the incident and assessment of the damage will be ongoing in the days or weeks to come. </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Statements regarding&nbsp;any future aspect of the incident on the <I>Deepwater Horizon</I>, the&nbsp;effects, results, investigation,
damage assessment&nbsp;relating thereto mitigation of environmental impact, as well as any other statements that are not historical facts, are forward-looking statements that involve certain risks, uncertainties and assumptions. These include but
are not limited to results of searches, investigations and assessments, actions by the Coast Guard and other governmental agencies, actions by customers and other third parties and other factors detailed in Transocean&#146;s most recent Form 10-K
and other filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), which are available free of charge on the SEC&#146;s website at <I><U>www.sec.gov</U></I>. Should one or more of these risks or uncertainties materialize, or should underlying
assumptions prove incorrect, actual results may vary materially from those indicated. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Transocean is the world&#146;s largest
offshore drilling contractor and the leading provider of drilling management services worldwide. With a fleet of 139 mobile offshore drilling units plus three ultra-deepwater units under construction, the company&#146;s fleet is considered one of
the most modern and versatile in the world due to its emphasis on technically demanding segments of the offshore drilling business. Its worldwide fleet is more than twice the size of the next-largest competitor. The company owns or operates a
contract drilling fleet of 45 High-Specification Floaters (Ultra-Deepwater, Deepwater and Harsh-Environment semisubmersibles and drillships), 26 Midwater Floaters, 10 High-Specification Jackups, 55 Standard Jackups and other assets utilized in the
support of offshore drilling activities worldwide. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT STYLE="font-family:Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For more information about Transocean, please visit our website at
<B></B><I><U></U></I><B><I><U>www.deepwater.com</U></I></B><I><U></U></I><B></B>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
